title: PRD-TOL-14 Tool Master
summary: Ledgerline Tool Master screen PRD-TOL-14 for maintaining tooling records, station allocations, and allowable operational life cycles.
body:
Screen PRD-TOL-14 provides master record maintenance for production tooling in Ledgerline, accessible under Menu Production > Tool master [^r7]. It is authorized for roles PRD-PLAN, PRD-SUP, QA-INSP, QA-MGR, and SYS-ADMIN [^r7]. The screen records tool identifiers, descriptions with station allocations, and rated operational life cycles [^r1][^r3]. If a tool is decommissioned after historical production lots exist, its record must be retained rather than deleted, and its description updated with an out-of-service note [^r5].

## Fields

* **TOOL CD** (`tool_cd`): Mandatory tool identifier acting as the primary record key in the underlying database table [^r1][^r3][^r8][^r11][^r12].
* **DESCR** (`descr`): Mandatory physical description and functional title specifying station allocation [^r1][^r3][^r8][^r11][^r12].
* **LIFE** (`life_cycles`): Optional integer field designating operational life rating in allowable cycles, operations, or working duration [^r1][^r3][^r8][^r11][^r12].

## Keys and services

PRD-TOL-14 interacts with the backend tool services [[services-prd-tool|PRD tool services]] [^r2][^r4]:

* **Get (F3)**: Executes command button `tool_get` calling service `TOOL MASTER GET` to retrieve existing tooling records [^r2][^r4][^r9][^r13].
* **Save (F8)**: Executes command button `tool_save` calling service `TOOL MASTER SAVE` at endpoint `POST /ll72/svc/tool_save` to commit new or amended tooling data [^r2][^r4][^r10][^r13].

## Messages

* `ERR-TOL-0001`: Displayed on the lower message line during get or save processing failures, such as Tool Master Not Found [^r6][^r13]. See [[err-tol-0001|ERR-TOL-0001 Tool Master Validation Failure]].

## See also

* [[err-tol-0001|ERR-TOL-0001 Tool Master Validation Failure]]
* [[services-prd-tool|PRD tool services]]
* [[screen-prd-wo-01|PRD-WO-01 Work Order Entry]]
* [[screen-prd-wc-10|PRD-WC-10 Work Centre]]
* [[screen-prd-mnt-07|PRD-MNT-07 Maintenance Order Entry]]

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: TOOL CD: The unique identification code assigned to the specific tool, jig, fixture, or piece of workshop equipment. This field acts as the primary record key in the underlying database table.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: The bottom command bar features the primary application actions: • The tool_get button (which calls background service TOOL MASTER GET). • The tool_save button (which calls background service TOOL MASTER SAVE).

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: Place the cursor in the TOOL CD field. Enter the code of the required tool.

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: Press the tool_get button, or press the assigned function key corresponding to the background service TOOL MASTER GET.

r5.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r5.quote: do not delete the record if historical production lots have been recorded against it. Instead, update the DESCR field with a clear status note

r6.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r6.quote: ERR-TOL-0001: This message appears on the lower message line when the service TOOL MASTER GET or TOOL MASTER SAVE fails to complete its validation or processing cycle.

r7.quote: Menu: Production > Tool master. Roles: [PRD-PLAN, PRD-SUP, QA-INSP, QA-MGR, SYS-ADMIN].

r8.quote: TOOL CD tool_cd str Yes DESCR descr str Yes LIFE life_cycles int

r9.quote: service: tool_get title: TOOL MASTER GET module: PRD kind: read screen: PRD-TOL-14

r10.quote: service: tool_save title: TOOL MASTER SAVE module: PRD kind: write screen: PRD-TOL-14

r11.quote: - {name: tool_cd, type: str, required: true, desc: TOOL} - {name: descr, type: str, required: true, desc: DESCR} - {name: life_cycles, type: int, required: false, desc: LIFE}

r12.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r12.quote: tool_cd TOOL CD Yes descr DESCR Yes life_cycles LIFE No

r13.quote: Get F3 tool_get Save F8 tool_save Tool Master Not Found ERR-TOL-0001
